mysteries.title: The Annunciation
mysteries.description: The Angel Gabriel announces to Mary that she will bear the Son of God
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with you!' (Luke 1:28)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for humility and acceptance of God's will in our lives.

mysteries.title: The Visitation
mysteries.description: Mary visits her cousin Elizabeth
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!' (Luke 1:42)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for charity and service to others, especially those in need.

mysteries.title: The Nativity
mysteries.description: Jesus is born in Bethlehem
mysteries.scripture_text: 'She gave birth to her firstborn son and wrapped him in swaddling clothes.' (Luke 2:7)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for detachment from worldly goods and simplicity of life.

mysteries.title: The Presentation
mysteries.description: Mary and Joseph present Jesus in the Temple
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Now, Master, you may let your servant go in peace, according to your word.' (Luke 2:29)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for obedience to God's will and purification of our intentions.

mysteries.title: The Finding in the Temple
mysteries.description: Jesus is found teaching in the Temple at age twelve
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Did you not know that I must be in my Father's house?' (Luke 2:49)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for true wisdom and devotion to our duties and responsibilities.

mysteries.title: The Agony in the Garden
mysteries.description: Jesus prays in anguish in the Garden of Gethsemane
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Father, if you are willing, take this cup away from me; still, not my will but yours be done.' (Luke 22:42)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for true contrition for our sins and perseverance in difficult times.

mysteries.title: The Scourging at the Pillar
mysteries.description: Jesus is brutally scourged by the Roman soldiers
mysteries.scripture_text: 'I find no guilt in this man.' (Luke 23:4)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for purity of soul and mortification of our senses.

mysteries.title: The Crowning with Thorns
mysteries.description: Jesus is mocked and crowned with thorns
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Hail, King of the Jews!' (Matthew 27:29)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for moral courage and mock the empty pleasures of the world.

mysteries.title: The Carrying of the Cross
mysteries.description: Jesus carries His cross to Calvary
mysteries.scripture_text: 'If anyone wishes to come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross daily.' (Luke 9:23)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for patience in bearing our crosses and making sacrifices for others.

mysteries.title: The Crucifixion
mysteries.description: Jesus dies on the cross for our sins
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Father, into your hands I commend my spirit.' (Luke 23:46)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for final perseverance and a holy death that leads to eternal life.

mysteries.title: The Resurrection
mysteries.description: Jesus rises from the dead on Easter Sunday
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Why do you seek the living one among the dead? He is not here, but he has been raised.' (Luke 24:5-6)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for faith in the resurrection and trust in God's promises.

mysteries.title: The Ascension
mysteries.description: Jesus ascends into Heaven forty days after His resurrection
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Go into the whole world and proclaim the gospel to every creature.' (Mark 16:15)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for hope in heavenly glory and detachment from earthly things.

mysteries.title: The Descent of the Holy Spirit
mysteries.description: The Holy Spirit descends upon the Apostles at Pentecost
mysteries.scripture_text: 'They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in different tongues.' (Acts 2:4)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for the gifts of the Holy Spirit and zeal for the mission of the Church.

mysteries.title: The Assumption of Mary
mysteries.description: Mary is taken up body and soul into Heaven
mysteries.scripture_text: 'A great sign appeared in the sky, a woman clothed with the sun.' (Revelation 12:1)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for devotion to Mary and a holy death that leads to eternal life.

mysteries.title: The Crowning of Mary as Queen of Heaven and Earth
mysteries.description: Mary is crowned Queen of Heaven and Earth
mysteries.scripture_text: 'A great sign appeared in the sky, a woman clothed with the sun.' (Revelation 12:1)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for trust in Mary's intercession and confidence in her maternal protection.

mysteries.title: The Baptism of Jesus
mysteries.description: Jesus is baptized by John the Baptist in the Jordan River
mysteries.scripture_text: 'This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.' (Matthew 3:17)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for openness to the Holy Spirit and acceptance of our vocation.

mysteries.title: The Wedding at Cana
mysteries.description: Jesus performs His first miracle at the wedding in Cana
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Do whatever he tells you.' (John 2:5)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for trust in Mary's intercession and obedience to the Word of God.

mysteries.title: The Proclamation of the Kingdom
mysteries.description: Jesus proclaims the Kingdom of God and calls all to conversion
mysteries.scripture_text: 'The kingdom of God is at hand. Repent, and believe in the gospel.' (Mark 1:15)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for repentance, conversion, and acceptance of the Gospel message.

mysteries.title: The Transfiguration
mysteries.description: Jesus is transfigured on Mount Tabor before Peter, James, and John
mysteries.scripture_text: 'This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased; listen to him.' (Matthew 17:5)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for spiritual transformation and the grace to become saints.

mysteries.title: The Institution of the Eucharist
mysteries.description: Jesus institutes the Eucharist at the Last Supper
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Take and eat; this is my body.' (Matthew 26:26)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for devotion to the Eucharist and frequent reception of Holy Communion.
